summary.short_description: The Mobile app basics page explains how Bosch mobile app design extends the Bosch UI Kit, distinguishes between the Bosch-branded App Library and the Native App Library, and defines when to use each library.
summary.core_message: Choose one mobile app library based on the app context and do not mix Bosch-branded and native elements, because the elements are coordinated only within their respective library.

libraries.name: Bosch-branded App Library
libraries.description: A mobile app design library that uses only Bosch UI Kit elements in combination with Mobile Foundations.
when: The app can be used on all types of mobile devices.
The app is part of a cross-platform solution, for example alongside websites or eShops.
libraries.goal: Ensure a consistent user experience across web and mobile platforms.

libraries.name: Native App Library
libraries.description: A mobile app design library based on native mobile elements adapted according to the Bosch Styleguide.
when: The app uses native functionalities and components such as address book or internal memory.
The app uses the full computing power of the device.
The app uses hardware functions such as camera, GPS, or touch sensors.
libraries.goal: Ensure that the app works optimally and fully exploits device functions.

if: App should work broadly across mobile device types.
App belongs to a broader cross-platform ecosystem.
decision_rules.rationale: It aligns the mobile experience with Bosch UI Kit and web touchpoints.

if: App depends on native components or device APIs.
App needs strong device performance or hardware access.
decision_rules.rationale: It better supports native behavior and full device capability usage.

if: A mobile app design uses components from Bosch-branded App Library and Native App Library together.
decision_rules.then: Avoid this combination and select only one library.
decision_rules.rationale: Elements are coordinated only within their respective library, so mixing them can reduce consistency.

principles: Use either the Bosch-branded App Library or the Native App Library.
Do not mix elements from Bosch-branded apps and native apps.
Maintain consistency by staying within the chosen library.

recommended.label: Do
recommended.description: Use elements from one mobile app library only.

not_recommended.label: Don't
not_recommended.description: Only using native elements when Bosch library guidance is required.

not_recommended.label: Don't
not_recommended.description: Mixing Bosch elements with native elements.
